name: Wahoo
verdict: Wahoo Fitness is owned by founder Chip Hawkins together with three investment partners since the 2023 buy-back. Nothing found.
note: US smart-trainer and cycling-electronics maker; upper-chest sponsor of the 2026 kit. Private company bought back from lenders by its founder and three partners in 2023; no state capital in the chain and no human-rights finding against the company found.
